chapter: Favorite bands, advice and family reflections
title: Advice to young trombonists
summary: He says first ask if they want to play, and tells of showing a small child to play; Cricket and Joe Orange appear.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: What would be your advice to young musicians and especially young trombonists? What would be your advice to somebody coming into the music field? What would be your advice? What would you say to a young trombone player coming into the music field?
Well, the first thing I would ask him is if he wanted to play trombone?

Well, I did that down around 10th Street. ... you don't remember. You were five years old. Living at 110th Street and I was practicing and these people lived under me, you know, like kids hear you play. So she told her mother that she wanted a trombone for Christmas. ... I taught this kid how to play Silent Night or something in about five minutes. So I think she was about five years old, couldn't have been over five. So I was showing the kid and Cricket said, Daddy give me the horn. I gave it to him. Say you play like this. She didn't play nothing but he moved and he didn't keep the slide. and a whole lot of notes came out ... But, back to the point, if you want to play, you'll play.
Well, what advice did you give to, Joe Orange did you ever give ... some advice about learning how to play the trombone?

No, I get some from him. (someone else talking). I get advice from everybody. No, I gave him a horn. So, he appreciated it and we went to (heard) Herbie going like mad... he had 3 trombonists, something like that. So I go up to his sisters sometimes and we'd sit down and practice. He can move ... and he knew
Well, what did you tell him a long time ago?
Yeah, about playing the trombone. You never gave him any advice?
I just asked him did he want it.
I know but you never gave him any advice?
JCH Jr. - used to tell him to play those old standards. (inaudible)
